liepinApi.scope: This card checks search and resume reading. Real submission requires a separately approved delivery route.
liepinApi.storageHint: The Token is saved in a local plaintext file with 0600 permissions, without Keychain, and loaded automatically after restart. It is never displayed or logged.
liepinApi.authorizationFailed: Could not open the system browser. Copy the address above and open it in your browser.
liepinApi.tokenPlaceholder: Paste Token; this field clears when submitted
liepinApi.resumeHint: Plain text preview on this page only. Nothing is saved or copied into your profile.
liepinApi.legacyHint: The existing browser delivery channels below have separate status from official read-only access.
liepinApi.requestError: The request did not complete. Check the backend connection and retry manually.
liepinApi.requestBlocked: The request was blocked. Check credential status and retry manually.

codes.AUTH_REQUIRED: Configure the official Liepin Token in System Settings first.
codes.AUTH_INVALID: The Token is invalid or unauthorized. Configure it again.
codes.RATE_LIMITED: Liepin has limited requests. Retry manually later.
codes.NETWORK_ERROR: Could not connect to Liepin. Check your network and retry manually.
codes.INVALID_RESPONSE: Liepin returned an unrecognized response. This action did not complete.
codes.API_ERROR: The Liepin API is unavailable. Retry manually later.
codes.INVALID_INPUT: Invalid input. Check it and retry.
codes.STORAGE_ERROR: Job leads could not be saved. Check local storage and retry.
codes.CREDENTIAL_STORAGE_ERROR: The local credential file operation failed. Check the storage path and file permissions, then retry.
codes.INTERNAL_ERROR: The request did not complete. Retry manually later.

evidenceInference.title: Evidence inference
evidenceInference.subtitle: Infer provenance-backed time/role candidates from documents; write to cards only after confirmation.
evidenceInference.enabledHint: When off, only rule-based L2 time hints are shown without model calls; accept/reject still applies.
evidenceInference.note: Candidates never write cards directly; accepted fields enter review and keep provenance/confidence.

materialSources.title: Material sources
materialSources.subtitle: External directories allowed for referencing (no copy; content changes are detected and blocked)
materialSources.label: Label (optional)
materialSources.removeConfirm: After removal, existing referenced materials will fail verification until the root is restored.

daily.title: Daily controlled delivery
daily.description: Runs one batch per Shanghai day while the app is running. Closing or sleeping stops execution; reopening handles today only. Uses fixed PDFs below and stops when attachment space is unavailable.
daily.scope: Specific jobs and fixed PDFs. New jobs, versions and attachment deletion require separate approval.
daily.empty: No unused prepared PDFs. Review a job, generate a PDF in Quick Run and fix it in Submissions. Uploaded or submitted runs are excluded.
daily.consent: I authorize uploading and submitting the saved PDFs to their listed Liepin jobs within this expiry and daily limit, including platform parsing into my online resume and inclusion with subsequent applications.

reasons.daily_scope_mismatch: Job or PDF differs from authorization
reasons.daily_pdf_filename_too_long: Liepin allows at most 24 characters including the extension. The abbreviated filename is still too long; nothing was uploaded.
reasons.daily_unresolved: An unresolved attempt or interrupted batch needs verification
reasons.daily_attachment_capacity: No unique upload input; attachment limit may be reached
reasons.daily_receipt_unknown: Receipt unconfirmed; reservation retained, further sending paused
reasons.daily_recovery_required: Interrupted items require verification in their original records.
reasons.NATIVE_OPERATION_BUSY: A platform operation is running. Wait for it to finish before closing an interrupted batch.
reasons.daily_run_unavailable: The batch has ended or is unavailable. Refresh to see its current results.

daily.recoveryHint: Stopped items need verification. Open their original records; the app will not retry uploads or submissions automatically. Successful and unstarted items retain their states.
daily.descriptionShort: While the app is open it delivers one batch a day at the set time, using only the pinned PDFs in the list.
daily.consentShort: I approve automatic upload and delivery of these PDFs per this list

materialDocument.title: Select a work document
materialDocument.help: Find source documents in imported materials. Select a bounded excerpt before extraction; the draft still requires review.
materialDocument.reReview: Review this card against its source

career.title: Complete career profile
career.help: Maintain employment, education and capabilities, linked to reviewed project evidence.
career.summaryHint: Leave blank to compose a summary from your confirmed position and latest work scope.
career.showEducation: Show education in the resume (uncheck to explicitly omit)
career.linkHint: Links identify work ownership. Maintain project-specific responsibilities, dates and results in Evidence.
career.stale: The profile changed elsewhere. Discard unsaved changes and refresh.
career.consent: I confirm the employer, position, dates, responsibilities, education and achievements are accurate.
career.autoLinkHint: Attach unlinked eligible evidence cards to a single work entry by material source, shared material and project time; conflicting cards are left for manual selection

deleteCard.title: Delete this evidence card?
deleteCard.description: This cannot be undone; matching reports and resumes that rely on it will not update automatically.

deleteArtifact.title: Remove this artifact?
deleteArtifact.description: Only the link to this card is removed; the local file stays.

clearSession.title: Clear the channel session?
clearSession.description: You will need to log in manually again before submitting.

retrySame.title: Queue a retry on the same channel?
retrySame.description: This sends the submission to the platform again. Check the job and resume version first.

retryFallback.title: Queue an email fallback retry?
retryFallback.description: The job will be resubmitted through the email channel.

clearCredential.title: Delete the saved Liepin credential?
clearCredential.description: The official read-only connection stops working until you paste a token again.

clearLlmKey.title: Delete the saved model key?
clearLlmKey.description: Deletes the local key for {{provider}}; the model, endpoint and other providers' keys are unchanged.

stop.title: Stop the current run?
stop.description: A stopped run does not resume on its own; generated candidates are kept.

reject.title: Reject this candidate?
reject.description: It will not be submitted and will not re-enter this review round.

approve.title: Approve and continue?
approve.description: Delivery checks continue per policy; whether anything is actually sent depends on the current authorization.

revoke.title: Revoke the daily delivery authorization?
revoke.description: Nothing runs automatically afterwards; save and confirm a new draft to resume.

run.title: Run today's batch now?
run.description: The fixed PDFs in the authorized list will be uploaded and submitted, using today's quota.

closeInterrupted.title: Close the interrupted batch?
closeInterrupted.description: Nothing is resent; confirmed and not-started items keep their state.

clearDraft.title: Clear the current draft?
clearDraft.description: Unsaved title, JD text and generated draft will be removed.

overwriteJd.title: Replace the current text with the fetched JD?
overwriteJd.description: The JD text and generated draft in the editor will be replaced.

archiveProfile.title: Archive this job profile?
archiveProfile.description: Archived profiles no longer appear as targets in Quick Run or Agent Run.

removeEntry.title: Remove this entry?
removeEntry.description: Use Reload to restore it before saving; after saving it cannot be undone.

reload.title: Discard unsaved profile changes?
reload.description: The saved profile will be reloaded.

evidence.draftGenerated: Draft generated; review and save it

resumes.careerAutoLinked: Linked {{applied}} cards automatically, {{unresolved}} undecided need manual selection; the profile changed, review and confirm again

jobs.converted: Lead converted to a job profile
jobs.detailFetched: Full JD loaded into the editor

jobs.titleRequired: Enter a job profile title below first

systemSettings.channelsNoSave: Nothing to save in the Channels section; use “Save locally” inside the Liepin card for the token

daily.notEditable: An enabled list is read-only; pause or revoke to edit
daily.notPausable: Only an active authorization can be paused
daily.notActivatable: Cannot enable in this state: only a draft or paused authorization can be enabled

career.consentStale: The profile changed elsewhere; reload it
career.consentMissing: Fill the missing items before confirming
career.autoLinkDirty: Save or discard current edits before auto-linking

sourceMerge.title: Add evidence from another document
sourceMerge.help: Select a source for the same project. Adopt exact text: replace period, role or context; append individual actions or results. Review and save the draft afterwards.
sourceMerge.quote: Paste a continuous quote from the selected document
sourceMerge.notFound: This quote was not found in the selected document. Check the text and source.
sourceMerge.confirm: I checked the project and personal ownership, preserving the source limits on plans, completion and verification.
sourceMerge.changed: A source or field citation has changed. This card cannot be used for generation until its sources are reviewed.

quality.title: Resume quality
quality.unrecorded: This historical PDF has no bound quality assessment. Quality is unrecorded; do not rely on its old match score alone.
quality.passed: Automatic quality checks passed; human review required
quality.failed: Automatic quality checks not passed; review each gap
quality.advisory: Scores are advisory. A source quote alone does not establish full requirements or personal ownership.
quality.scope: Scope: {{qualification_count}} qualifications, {{responsibility_count}} responsibilities, {{check_count}} source clauses. Unrecognized responsibilities are not counted as covered.

report.title: Four-tier quality report
report.missing: This evaluation has no four-tier quality report (legacy result). Regenerate and evaluate again.
report.blockedBy: (lower tier not passed; this tier is advisory only: {{tier}})
report.noFailures: No rule failures in this tier.
report.llmPending: LLM judgements incomplete or missing coverage: {{rules}}
report.legacy: Compare legacy scores (not used for pass judgement)
report.decisionSaved: Highlight decision saved; re-evaluate to apply.

advice.heading: Application advice
advice.advisory: Advisory only; it does not block applying. The final decision is yours.

recommendation.reconsider: Add evidence or choose a closer target
recommendation.fix_facts: Verify facts and hard requirements first
